I don't understand the paragraph about the build number, there is a mention of asking Google and getting 1308, followed by saying the logs say 1313 is the build number.

https://help.vrchat.com/hc/en-us/articles/1500002247921-VRChat-keeps-crashing-or-has-issues-launching-properly

That link describe how to clear information, bit of a nuclear option, if you do it, you get the log in prompt again, and get to visit the tutorial world and you'll be finding out setting to tweak for weeks to come. 

The page also seems to link to a helpdesk type support site, rather than this feedback site, although I didn't try filling anything. Maybe they can suggest a registry entry that can be deleted to force visiting the login screen.

Silly issue like this I'm hoping it resolved itself by now.

details:
Description: Unable to cease the log in process after accidentally clicking "log in with steam" instead of "log in with vrchat" in the initial log in screen despite hitting cancel button during steam log in process, and despite quitting and relaunching vrchat application.

When the steam login process was going, i hit the cancel button at least four times, but all it would do was restart the steam login screen (reset the circular progress bar back to 0%) and continue trying to log me in with steam. Finally i let it finish loading to see if a later screen would let me cancel. Then a screen appeared saying i needed to verify my age, and the only option was to continue, with no ability to go back to the initial screen. Even quitting the app and relaunching it presents me immediately with the request to confirm my age. 

Since the mouse icon becomes invisible temporarily when switching to the app due to vrchat having its own mouse icon, it is easy to click on the wrong log in button, with no way to go back.

The VRchat website says to include output logs with bug reports but only accepts image uploads so here is the pertinent part. Also, I do not know where I am meant to find my build number because the input box gives the location of the number as being located in "settings > debug> build". I have no idea what 'settings' this refers to, is this supposed to be the build number that vrchat would show me if I could access the game? I put 1308 because that is what google has as the current open beta, but here is the build number according to my logs in case it is helpful: 2023.2.3p2-1313-feb9622dbb-Release

Thank you
